description: Compare each status's average image count with the mean of the status-level averages.

a.request: Join each environment record to its site by site code, dropping records without a matching site, and group by the site's access status (`entrystat`). For each status, return the status, the average ambient temperature (`ambictemp`), the average number of images (`imgcount`), and that image average minus the simple mean of the per-status image averages, with each status counting equally. Averages ignore missing values. Don't round.
a.sql: WITH per_status AS (SELECT s.entrystat AS entrystat, AVG(e.ambictemp) AS avg_temp, AVG(e.imgcount) AS avg_img FROM scanenvironment e INNER JOIN sites s ON e.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, avg_temp, avg_img, avg_img - (SELECT AVG(avg_img) FROM per_status) AS img_diff_from_mean FROM per_status

c.request: For environment records that match a site, show each site access status (`entrystat`) with its average ambient temperature (`ambictemp`) and average image count (`imgcount`). Also show how far that image-count average sits above or below the average image count overall (status average minus overall). Ignore missing values and don't round. Compare each status's average image count with the mean of the status-level averages.
c.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT st.entrystat AS entrystat, AVG(e.ambictemp) AS avg_ambictemp, AVG(e.imgcount) AS avg_imgcount FROM scanenvironment e JOIN sites st ON e.zoneref = st.zoneregistry WHERE st.entrystat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY st.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, avg_ambictemp, avg_imgcount, avg_imgcount - AVG(avg_imgcount) OVER () AS imgcount_diff_from_overall FROM s

b.request: For environment records joined to sites, show each site access status (`entrystat`) with its average ambient temperature and average image count, plus the difference between that status's average image count and the mean of all the status-level average image counts (an unweighted average of the per-status averages, not the average over individual records), ignoring NULLs and applying no rounding
b.sql: WITH per_status AS (SELECT s.entrystat AS entrystat, AVG(e.ambictemp) AS avg_ambient_temp, AVG(e.imgcount) AS avg_image_count FROM scanenvironment e JOIN sites s ON e.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, avg_ambient_temp, avg_image_count, avg_image_count - AVG(avg_image_count) OVER () AS diff_from_mean_of_status_avgs FROM per_status

d.request: For environment records that match a site, show each site access status (`entrystat`) with its average ambient temperature (`ambictemp`) and average image count (`imgcount`). Also show how far each status's average image count sits above or below the mean of the status-level average image counts (status average minus the mean of those averages). Ignore missing values and don't round.
d.sql: SELECT entrystat, AVG(ambictemp) AS avg_ambictemp, AVG(imgcount) AS avg_imgcount, AVG(imgcount) - AVG(AVG(imgcount)) OVER () AS diff_from_mean_of_avgs FROM (SELECT s.entrystat, e.ambictemp, e.imgcount FROM scanenvironment e JOIN sites s ON e.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE s.entrystat IS NOT NULL) t GROUP BY entrystat
